root_cause_label: Attention Omitted and Wrong Token IDs: Broken GPT-2 Forward Pass
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent generated a fundamentally broken GPT-2 forward pass that replaced multi-head self-attention with a simple linear projection over the value slice, used raw byte values (0-255) as token IDs instead of BPE-encoded vocabulary indices, and declared success despite producing degenerate output (token 46107 repeated 20 times).
t_err_evidence: Step 34 introduces the 'transformer' function that explicitly comments '// Skip attention computation for now...' and replaces the full QKV multi-head self-attention with 'matvec(attn_out, qkv+D*2, w, D, D)' — a single linear projection of only the value slice using D*D weights — while also committing to using raw byte values (0-255) as token IDs in 'bpe_encode' instead of performing BPE merges. Both decisions (no real attention, wrong token IDs) are locked in at this edit.
t_commit_evidence: Step 34 is also t_commit: the broken attention-omitting transformer function and byte-as-token-ID tokenizer are adopted here and never corrected in any subsequent edit. All later iterations (steps 37, 43, 47, 50, 53) produce identical degenerate output of token 46107 repeated 20 times, confirming the outcome was locked in at this edit.
t_surface_evidence: Step 37 is the first successful run of the C program producing observable failure: '46107 46107 46107 46107 46107 46107 46107 46107 46107 46107 46107 46107 46107 46107 46107 46107 46107 46107 46107 46107' — all 20 generated tokens are the same value, indicating a degenerate model that does not perform valid GPT-2 inference.
trigger_explanation: The agent recognized the need for multi-head self-attention in its planning steps (23, 29, 39) but lacked the ability to generate correct masked self-attention code within the 5000-byte constraint. Instead of implementing even a minimal but correct attention mechanism, it substituted a fundamentally wrong approximation (linear projection of only the V slice) and acknowledged it was 'skipping attention computation for now' — a substitution it never corrected. Similarly, the tokenizer mapped raw ASCII byte values to token IDs rather than performing BPE merges, producing token IDs in range 0-255 which do not map to valid GPT-2 vocabulary entries.
forewarning_evidence: Step 23 (think log): 'This seems impossible for a full implementation. Maybe the user expects a very minimal proof-of-concept?' and 'let me actually try to write the smallest possible C program that at least compiles and runs, even if it doesn't work correctly.' Step 29 (think log): 'Actually, I could cheat: Implement only the embedding lookup and output projection (skip all layers) ... But that's not GPT-2.' These self-doubt expressions signal awareness that the planned approach would be incorrect, before the broken code was committed at step 34.
